_doc: Verdant Sink level-owned lines (signs, hints, objectives, relay labels, prompts, the sail scene, picket corn chants). Registered by LevelKit.register_lines through LevelDirector.setup, and in VOManager.LINE_SOURCES. Story lines (cs.*, st.*, memo.*, code.*) stay in bs/story; Compost King lines in bs/bosses.json; Glide lines in bs/gadgets.json.

bs.verdant.sign_welcome.text:
TERRAFARM™ WELCOMES YOU
THE FUTURE OF FOOD (PATENT PENDING)

bs.verdant.sign_union.text:
CORN UNION LOCAL 404
MEETING IN PROGRESS

bs.verdant.sign_cellar.text:
THE ROOT CELLAR
(the crops keep their prisoners here)

bs.verdant.sign_harvester.text:
MEGA-HARVESTER HR-9
DO NOT REASON WITH IT

bs.verdant.hint_murk.text: The dark water is MURK: it slows you and it burns. Boardwalks and caps stay dry.

bs.verdant.hint_puffball.text: Land on a puffball to bounce. Hold JUMP on the way up for more height.

bs.verdant.hint_picket.text: The picket line guards the harvester. Local 404 only lets members cross: see the Union Hall (west).

bs.verdant.hint_silo.text: Climb the silo: sacks, chutes and rafters up to the loft where the sail is woven.

bs.verdant.hint_cellar.text: The Root Cellar: a GLAMBOT pop-up waits in THE COMPOST RING once he's on our side.

bs.verdant.hint_bounce.text: Bounce mushrooms are the express lifts. Chain them up the caps to the canopy.

bs.verdant.hint_boom.text: The fallen grain boom is a ride-rail. Its broken end is a GLIDE gap: hold JUMP after the hover runs out.

bs.verdant.hint_cab.text: The cab hatch drops into the harvester's guts: belts, hoppers and threshing drums down to the reactor bay.

bs.verdant.hint_arm.text: The broken arm hangs over the lagoon. The north valve on the reactor collar is a glide from here.

bs.verdant.hint_lagoon.text: Three coolant leaks poison the lagoon. Seal a valve: three mallet hits on the wheel, or interact at it.

bs.verdant.obj_union.text: Get past the picket line: see Local 404 at the Union Hall (west)

bs.verdant.obj_boom.text: Climb the Spore Groves to the grain boom and glide into the harvester

bs.verdant.obj_leaks.text: Seal the three coolant leaks while the Compost King thrashes

bs.verdant.obj_core.text: Take the Keystone Core from the drained outfall

bs.verdant.obj_exit.text: Return Relay online: back to the landing pad

bs.verdant.popup_locked.text: A pop-up stage with nobody hosting it. GLAMBOT isn't ours yet. Rustvane first.

bs.verdant.popup_start.text: PICKET LINE! Four waves come for six corn. Hit a corn and you've crossed the line. GO!

bs.verdant.popup_done.text: LINE HELD! The strike fund pays 240 bolts and the corn would like you to know they saw everything.

bs.verdant.picket_fail_sub.text: The challenge is void. Solidarity has a memory.

bs.verdant.picket_line_01.text: Members only past this point, sibling. Nothing personal. Everything collective.

bs.verdant.picket_line_02.text: Card-carrying! Through you go. Mind the murk and tell HR-9 we said nothing.

bs.verdant.groves_clear.text: Grove's quiet. The caps are glowing harder. I think they're... pleased?

bs.verdant.annex_line.text: The root gate's open. 'The crops keep their prisoners here.' I have never been more polite to a hallway.

bs.verdant.glide.01.text: Local 404 moves that the mechanic be issued a solidarity sail. Husk-silk. Woven on the night shift. All in favour?

bs.verdant.glide.02.text: Wait, it goes on ME? I'm the sail? I'm the SAIL?

bs.verdant.glide.03.text: Motion carries. The small one is the sail. Dental is extended to the small one.

bs.verdant.glide.04.text: Fine. FINE. Hold JUMP when the hover gives out and I'll catch the air. Three metres out for every metre down. Don't test the maths.

bs.verdant.glide.05.text: I'm going to test the maths.

bs.verdant.pump_sub.text: The pool flushes clear: 100 bolts on its bed

bs.verdant.cache_sub.text: 80 bolts and a full reload, under the harvester's belly

bs.verdant.qhint_q7a.text: Hear that buzzing? Sounds like a performance review. Pollinator. Scab. Swat it for the union.

bs.verdant.qhint_q7b.text: That hiss is coolant. A sealant core's close. Cornelius will want it.

bs.verdant.king_npc_01.text: Local 404 took me in. I do the composting now. Officially. With a badge.

bs.verdant.king_npc_02.text: The pipes are quiet. I sleep. I had forgotten sleeping.

bs.verdant.corn_hit.text: That's a grievance, sibling. Twenty seconds of grievance.
